description: Verify and fix canonical pipeline integrity issues identified in review.json. Address: (1) Verify _extract_canonical_snapshot uses extract_feature_snapshot, (2) Instantiate DataQualityEngine and populate snapshot.data_quality_report, (3) Search and destroy hardcoded model_agreement=1.0 and data_quality_score=0.7, (4) Verify ensemble model_agreement flows to confidence assessment, (5) Verify calibration metadata includes is_fitted status. This is surgical fixes to existing pipeline, not rebuild.
steps: If _extract_canonical_snapshot doesn't exist or doesn't call extract_feature_snapshot from feature_snapshot.py, implement it correctly
Read backend/app/prediction/feature_snapshot.py extract_feature_snapshot() to understand signature and DataQualityEngine usage
If DataQualityEngine not instantiated in PredictionService.__init__, add: from app.prediction.data_quality import DataQualityEngine; self.data_quality_engine = DataQualityEngine()
Update extract_feature_snapshot or _extract_canonical_snapshot to call data_quality_engine and populate snapshot.data_quality_report

Search for hardcoded confidence values: cd backend && Select-String -Path 'app\prediction\*.py' -Pattern 'model_agreement\s*=\s*(0\.\d+|1\.0)' | Where-Object { $_.Line -notmatch '^(\s*#|.*def.*model_agreement)' }
For each match in production code (not tests, not function signatures), replace with real pipeline value: orchestration_result.model_agreement or ensemble_result.metadata.get('model_agreement', 0.0)
Search for hardcoded data quality: cd backend && Select-String -Path 'app\prediction\*.py' -Pattern 'data_quality.*=\s*0\.\d+' | Where-Object { $_.Line -notmatch '^(\s*#|.*def.*data_quality)' }
Replace with snapshot.data_quality_report.overall_score if snapshot.data_quality_report else 0.5 (with clear comment explaining fallback)
Read generate_full_prediction() STEP 5 (confidence assessment, lines 836+) and verify it receives real model_agreement from orchestration_result or ensemble_result.metadata
Read calibration_engine.py and verify Calibrator1X2 exposes is_fitted property or metadata field
If not exposed, add is_fitted property to Calibrator1X2 class
Update CalibrationIntegration.calibrate_prediction to include is_fitted in returned metadata
Run component tests: cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/test_confidence_engine.py tests/test_calibration_engine.py tests/test_model_orchestrator.py -v
Run integration test: cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/test_prediction_service.py::TestDevelopmentDataFallback -v
Verify no hardcoded values remain: rerun search commands from steps 6 and 8
acceptance_criteria: _extract_canonical_snapshot exists and calls extract_feature_snapshot from feature_snapshot.py
snapshot.data_quality_report populated with real quality assessment (not None)
No hardcoded model_agreement=1.0 in production code (tests/defaults in __init__ OK)
No hardcoded data_quality_score=0.7 in production code
Confidence assessment receives real model_agreement from ensemble
Integration test passes with real pipeline values
